official.application_cycle: Call opened 11 August 2026 for fellowships starting between March and June 2027
official.status_note: The call page states the application period runs from 11 August 2026 with a closing date of 12 October 2026 and results notified on 30 November 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Not a degree programme; the call states no tuition figure or coverage, only a competitive remuneration for the residency.
benefits: Remuneracion competitiva (competitive remuneration) during the two-to-three-month residency
Reimbursement of the round-trip airfare to the CALAS host seat
Use of CALAS and host institution resources, including office space, library access and research facilities
Participation in local and digital CALAS activities and presentation of research progress at the seat
Publication option as a long essay (paperback of about 60-80 pages) in the CALAS collection 'Afrontar las Crisis - Crear Horizontes', otherwise as a scientific article
eligibility: Open to academics with training in the social sciences and humanities (Ciencias Sociales y Humanidades)
Minimum academic degree required is a doctorate (doctorado)
Operational command of Spanish (dominio operativo del espanol) is required
Ideally recognised nationally or internationally for the impact of their research
Scientific work, reputation, publications, research experience and the quality of the submitted project are evaluated
Open to applicants of any nationality
requirements: Reside for 2 to 3 months at the chosen CALAS seat (Costa Rica or Ecuador)
Take part in activities and events organised at local or digital level
Present research progress at the seat
Submit a 5-page activity report at the end of the fellowship
documents: Cover letter explaining why the project fits the specific fellowship and the applicant's expectations
Short CV (2 pages) including a list of publications related to the project
Copy of the doctoral degree certificate
Research project proposal with research calendar, work plan and max. 10 bibliographic sources (4 pages max / 2000 words)
All documents as PDF, in Spanish or English
selection_criteria: Experience in the field of research
coverage: Competitive remuneration for the residency period (amount not published)
Round-trip air ticket reimbursement to the respective CALAS seat
Office space, library access and research facilities at CALAS and the host institution
CALAS expressly states it cannot provide accommodation, but local administrative staff will help fellows find places to rent
application_method: Fill in the CALAS online application form
Attach the required documents as PDFs in Spanish or English
official.application_route: Complete the online CALAS application form and attach the four PDF documents in Spanish or English.
official.international_eligibility: Open to applicants of any nationality
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Social sciences and humanities; proposals must address the guiding research questions of the CALAS transdisciplinary programme 'Creando horizontes: aceleraciones, transformaciones, emergencias'; specialists in cultural and literary studies are especially encouraged to submit proposals
official.research_requirement: A research project proposal with calendar, work plan and up to 10 sources (max 4 pages / 2000 words)
official.duration: 2 to 3 months in residence, starting between March and June 2027
official.description: CALAS, the Maria Sibylla Merian Centre for Advanced Latin American Studies in Humanities and Social Sciences, and Bielefeld University offer two research fellowships of two to three months for qualified researchers to work in residence at the Central America and the Caribbean seat in San Jose, Costa Rica, or the Andean seat at FLACSO, Ecuador.
official.english_requirement: Documents may be submitted in Spanish or English; operational command of Spanish is required for the fellowship itself.

verification.notes: Call text and downloadable PDF of the official CALAS call (calas.lat) and its Universidad de Guadalajara CUCSH mirror were read in full; no remuneration figure, currency or payment period is published anywhere on them - the call only says 'remuneracion competitiva' - so those fields stay null. Deadline, seats, documents, eligibility and benefits verified word for word.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a short, senior-level residency rather than a degree scholarship: you must already hold a doctorate and be able to relocate to San Jose or Quito for two to three months in 2027. The money side is deliberately thin on detail, so budget as if only the airfare is guaranteed - CALAS states plainly that it cannot house fellows. Your competitive edge is a project that visibly speaks to CALAS's crisis-and-horizons agenda and a publication record that a reviewer can check.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Doctorate-holding social science and humanities researchers with publications and working Spanish who can spend a spring or summer 2027 residency in Costa Rica or Ecuador.
application_readiness_checklist: Trim the CV to exactly 2 pages and list only publications related to the project
Build the proposal to the hard limits: 4 pages / 2000 words, work plan, calendar, max 10 bibliographic sources
Write the cover letter against this specific seat (Costa Rica vs Ecuador) and name what you expect from the residency
Scan the doctorate certificate as PDF and keep every file in Spanish or English
Line up a rental contact in San Jose or Quito early, since accommodation is yours to solve
common_rejection_risks: Proposal drifts off the CALAS 'Creando horizontes' research questions into a generic Latin American topic
Over-length documents: the 2-page CV, 4-page/2000-word proposal and 10-source cap are explicit
No doctoral certificate attached, or certificates not as PDF
Applying without working Spanish, which the call lists as a requirement
Assuming housing is included and later withdrawing when it is not
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Rent, food, local transport and daily living costs in San Jose or Quito for 2-3 months - only the remuneration (unquantified) and the round-trip flight are covered; nothing is published about insurance or visa support.
document_audit: The proposal must read as a proposal, not a thesis chapter: objectives, methodology and expected results inside 4 pages
The doctorate certificate must be a copy of the actual doctoral degree (título de doctorado), not a master's degree
Cover letter must justify fit to this specific fellowship and seat, not to CALAS in general
alerts: Applications close 12 October 2026 and results are only notified on 30 November 2026, for a stay starting March-June 2027 - plan visa and rental timelines around that lag
CALAS warns that, given the expected volume of applications, rejections will not be justified
Cultural and literary studies proposals are expressly encouraged this round
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Fill the CALAS online form, upload the four PDFs (cover letter, 2-page CV, doctorate certificate copy, proposal), and wait for the 30 November 2026 notification; the fellowship itself is arranged directly with the chosen seat.
